# Vendored browser test tooling

`axe.min.js` is axe-core 4.14.0, downloaded from the official npm package
`axe-core@4.14.0` for accessibility checks in the isolated browser E2E harness.
The application does not import it and it is not an npm dependency.

- Release: https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core/releases/tag/v4.14.0
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/axe-core/v/4.14.0
- Package integrity: `sha512-9WTZxEjsZ7b13TH8JPmbV2z8CHbl80/2hm3XPEG4JgNdQLK81IBRXmSxHfMAOkSqQeRxT/0dwNDz2GOm3zzpcQ==`
- License: MPL-2.0, included in `axe-core-LICENSE.txt`
- Third-party notices: `axe-core-LICENSE-3RD-PARTY.txt`

Keep both notices with the vendored source. Review the upstream license and
version before updating this file.
